permit.applies: The Immigration and Citizenship Agency processes and issues the permit, verifying the employer and the employment details.

sources.title: Immigration and Citizenship Agency (Somalia), Services
sources.said: The Agency processes and issues work permits for foreign nationals employed in Somalia, supporting lawful employment while protecting the domestic labour market. What we provide Processing and issuance of work permits Permit renewals and amendments Verification of employer and employment details Requirements Requirements for this service hav
